title: Caramelized Onion Pan Sauce
description: A rich pan sauce built on slow-caramelized onions, white wine, and chicken stock, finished with cold butter for a glossy, velvety consistency.

vegetarian.notes: Swap chicken stock for vegetable stock — same quantity, same pan, no extra steps.

steps.title: Caramelize the onion
steps.text: Melt a small amount of {i01} in a wide skillet or saucepan over medium-low heat. Add {i02} and a pinch of {i03}. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden and caramelized.

steps.title: Add garlic
steps.text: Add {i04} to the caramelized onions and cook, stirring, for about 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.text: Pour in {i05} and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. Simmer until the wine is nearly fully reduced.

steps.title: Reduce the stock
steps.text: Add {i06} and bring to a simmer. Reduce until the sauce is thickened and concentrated, roughly by half.

steps.title: Mount with cold butter
steps.text: Remove the pan from heat or reduce to very low. Add the remaining cold {i01} a few cubes at a time, swirling or whisking constantly until the sauce is glossy and emulsified. Season with {i03} to taste.

How to make a caramelized onion butter sauce 🧅

Sign up for my newsletter to keep up to date with recipes and cooking techniques! Comment “NEWSLETTER” and I’ll send you a link to your DMs to join my community!

Ingredients:
* 8 Tbsp butter, cold
* 1 onion, julienned
* Salt to taste
* 3 garlic cloves, minced
* 1 cup white wine
* 2 cup chicken stock
